faqs.q: Arizona LSU Forms (Loan Status Updates) and what you need to know
faqs.a: When you’re buying or selling a home, the LSU is a critical document that updates the seller on how far along the buyer’s loan process is.

The LSU form is two pages long and contains two key sections:
Page 1: Mostly repeats the information from the pre-qualification form (loan type, amount, property address, buyer & seller details).
Page 2: A detailed checklist of loan milestones, showing what’s been completed and what’s still pending.
